description: A React functional component for a dialog that allows users to add or edit text annotations on a Plotly chart. It manages form state, initializes with existing annotation data if editing, and provides UI controls for annotation properties like text, color, size, and position.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles input changes, updating the form data state, with conversions for numeric fields.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Closes the dialog by invoking the passed close callback.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Validates and submits the annotation data; adds or updates annotations accordingly.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes the current annotation if in edit mode.
